summary.study: Exact Q8 decode gate/up callback SwiGLU fusion screening
summary.scope: Synthetic scratch grouped Q8 projections plus unchanged SwiGLU. Original CPU pool, dot arithmetic and activation buffers. This is neither HF validation nor a real-model performance gate.

plan.scope: Synthetic scratch group plus unchanged SwiGLU, not model throughput or external floor. Both arms use same concrete Q8 helper, not production generic dispatch timing.
plan.order: Even measured pairs serial/fused, odd fused/serial; discarded pair serial/fused. Shapes small then large. No sample removal.
plan.advance_rule: Both shapes require lower fused mean AND median and at least 6/9 paired wins; at least one shape requires at least 2% lower mean AND median. Otherwise stop this fusion experiment before model integration.
plan.prerequisites: Independent MSVC/GCC numerical and source preflight pass, mutation rejected, all builds/oracles terminal, process guard empty.
plan.limits: Synthetic matrices repeat in cache. Benefit does not establish real-model gain. No approximation, rounding-mode changes, model API or buffers removed.
